assessment: This manuscript reports high-resolution crystallographic structures of the L,D-transpeptidase from Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which was obtained with ligands (a sugar molecule and a β-lactam). A surprising finding is that the enzyme contains a ligand-binding site located greater than 20 Å away from the catalytic site. The authors used mutagenesis studies and computational analyses to support an allosteric role for the new ligand site (S-pocket). This site could potentially permit the inhibition of L,D-transpeptidases.
